newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 9.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
* Iraqi Kurds backed by President Saddam Hussein invaded the northern Iraq city of Koi Sanjaq on Sunday, forcing the evacuation of thousands of civilians and hundreds of armed guerillas.
* Five years after his defeat in the Gulf War, Saddam Hussein has reconstructed an army capable of major military offences, diplomats and military analysts say.
* The after-effects of Hurrican Fran were felt along the eastern seaboard of the United States, causing flooded rivers and thunderstorms.
* Campaign consultants and have captured the media spotlight following the scandal of Dick Morris, who resigned from re-election campaign of President Clinton.
* Former Haitian President Jean Bertrand Aristide remains a favourite in his country long after relinquishing the office in February.

* Health management organisations, now in use by public assistance programmes, have softened the task of welfare recipients seeking medical care by directing them to doctors' offices rather than crowded hospital emergency rooms.
